attributes.description: Disconnects, failed pings and failed connectivity tests.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.connection-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("cm-connection-disconnected", "cm-ping-failed")
    OR (event.action == "connectivity-test-completed" AND steam.connection.connectivity_test.result != "OK!")
    OR (event.action == "ip-stack-connectivity-test-completed" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL problem = CASE(event.action == "cm-connection-disconnected", "Disconnect",
    event.action == "cm-ping-failed", "Ping failure", "Connectivity test failed"),
  reason = COALESCE(steam.connection.disconnect.reason, steam.connection.ping.failure_reason,
    steam.connection.connectivity_test.result, steam.connection.ip_stack_test.outcome)
| STATS problems = COUNT(*) BY timestamp = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), problem

attributes.description: Disconnects, failed pings and failed connectivity tests, by reason.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.connection-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("cm-connection-disconnected", "cm-ping-failed")
    OR (event.action == "connectivity-test-completed" AND steam.connection.connectivity_test.result != "OK!")
    OR (event.action == "ip-stack-connectivity-test-completed" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| EVAL problem = CASE(event.action == "cm-connection-disconnected", "Disconnect",
    event.action == "cm-ping-failed", "Ping failure", "Connectivity test failed"),
  reason = COALESCE(steam.connection.disconnect.reason, steam.connection.ping.failure_reason,
    steam.connection.connectivity_test.result, steam.connection.ip_stack_test.outcome)
| STATS count = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY problem, reason
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20

attributes.description: Sync passes started and deferred, by game.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.cloud-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("cloud-sync-started", "cloud-sync-deferred")
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS Started = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "cloud-sync-started", Deferred = COUNT(*) WHERE event.action == "cloud-sync-deferred" BY application
| SORT Started + Deferred DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM logs-steam.cloud-*

attributes.description: Failed Workshop operations by game and result.

query.esql:
FROM logs-steam.workshop-*
| WHERE event.outcome == "failure"
| LOOKUP JOIN steam_lookup.app_name ON steam.app.id
| EVAL application = COALESCE(steam.app.name, steam.app.id)
| STATS failures = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY application, action = event.action, result = steam.workshop.item.result
| SORT failures DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-steam.workshop-*
